description: Fetch a URL and get it back ready for an LLM or RAG pipeline: clean markdown (headings and links kept), plain text, the title, the page's links and fetch metadata. POST /v1/extract with {url} and optional formats and max_chars. JSON in, JSON out, errors included. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: An extraction request. The body is JSON and is bounded by the service at 16 KiB.

url.description: The page to fetch (http or https).

formats.description: Which renderings to return. Defaults to the service's own choice.

outputSchema.description: For POST /v1/extract, a JSON object with request_id, url, title, markdown, text, links (href and text), meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). A bad request answers 400 with `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`.
